findings.claim: The DepthStep change from >= to > in MessagePackSecurity raises the effective maximum object graph depth by one. It is unrelated to the SuppressSourceGeneration analyzer bug. It also loosens a security limit, and L9 records a deliberate depth limit of 500. L18 gives no decision on it, so scope creep and a security behavior change remain.
